questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information

 given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly

 known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the

 statements.

 Statements:

 All warriors are politicians.

 All leaders are knights.

 Some knights are warriors.

 Conclusions:

 (I) Some warriors are leaders.

 (II) Some politicians are knights.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/597df0a0c2160d2faa811ca21bfb4cd9bbc9f8f3c5c0f5888efdc898d50ba4d2.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some warriors are leaders → Does not follow (As all leaders are knights and some knights are warriors. So it is possible but not definite)

(II) Some politicians are knights → **F**ollow (As all warriors are politicians and some knights are warriors. As some part pf knights is common with warriors which whole comes in politicians, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

 (Left) 412 366 307 241 667 (Right)

 (Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

 (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

 What will be the resultant if the first digit of the highest number is subtracted from the

 third digit of the lowest number?
questions.solution:

 Number given

 307
 241
 667
 
 

 Arranged in ascending order
 241
 307
 366

 667
 
 

First digit of the highest number → **6**67 → 6

Third digit of the lowest number → 24**1** → 1

So, the first digit of the highest number is subtracted from the third digit of the lowest number → (1 - 6) = -5

questions.question: In a row of 81 students facing north, Sima is 12th from the right end. If Manju is 9th to the left of Sima, what is Manju’s position from the left end of the line?
questions.solution:
Given: 

1) In a row of 81 students facing north, Sima is 12th from the right end.

2) Manju is 9th to the left of Sima.

Total students = 81

Sima's rank from the right end = 12th

Manju's rank from the right end = 12 + 9 → 21st

Manju's rank from the left end = Total students - Manju's rank from the right end + 1

= 81 - 21 + 1

= 61

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
